gateRationale: The canonical-package workflow preserved both fixed research markers in exactly two w:vanish runs and preserved all three visible fixture paragraphs.
The google-docs-roundtrip-docx workflow preserved all three visible fixture paragraphs but removed Signal Alpha, Signal Beta, and all w:vanish runs.
The google-docs-copy-plain-text workflow preserved the visible fixture while carrying neither fixed marker.
Because every completed material editor round-trip lost both markers and only the canonical package retained them, the frozen gate requires ABANDON CURRENT CARRIER.
limitations: This decision is scoped to the tested Google Docs import/export and ordinary copy/paste workflows.
Microsoft Word round-trip, clipboard, hidden-text display, and accessibility behavior remain unassessed because Microsoft Word was unavailable.
Google Docs accessibility or assistive-technology exposure was not assessed.
The Google Docs exported DOCX was examined with a read-only ZIP/XML inspection but was not validated by the strict canonical package-layout allowlist.
